nodes.description: SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b) pure: adds two values and requires c >= a to prevent overflow.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b <= a then subtracts, preventing underflow.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b) pure: multiplies and checks a == 0 || c / a == b to prevent overflow.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b) pure: requires b > 0 then divides.
ZAO.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
ZAO.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
ZAO.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits balances[msg.sender], credits balances[to] using safeSub/safeAdd, emits Transfer.
ZAO.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
ZAO.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits balances[to].
ZAO.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
ZAO.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, an externally controlled callback.
ZAO fallback function: payable but immediately reverts, rejecting ETH.
ZAO.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: performs external ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stores pending newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
ZAO constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-assigns all balances to a fixed address, emitting Transfer.
Owned.owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address used by acceptOwnership.
ZAO.symbol public string token symbol.
ZAO.name public string token name.
ZAO.decimals public uint8 token decimals.
ZAO._totalSupply: total token supply backing totalSupply().
mapping(address => uint) balances: per-account token balances.

Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance keys.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the privileged owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership logic runs.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, making the caller the access-control subject.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner, which reads msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the caller address as key.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender], the caller being the spender.
approveAndCall forwards msg.sender into the external receiveApproval callback after the allowance is written.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for both sender and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance before crediting the recipient.
approve stores the allowance into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before making the external call.
approveAndCall transfers control to the attacker-controlled unsafe operation receiveApproval.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter transferFrom/approve while the freshly written allowance is still in place.
Code reached through the callback may read or modify the allowed mapping mid-transaction.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external ERC20 transfer unsafe operation.
Only the owner address receives tokens transferred out by transferAnyERC20Token.
totalSupply returns a value derived from the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The ZAO constructor initializes the _totalSupply state variable.
The ZAO constructor assigns the entire supply into balances of a fixed address.
The ZAO constructor sets the symbol string.
The ZAO constructor sets the name string.
The ZAO constructor sets the decimals value.

Parameter b has no security role of its own and only feeds the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
Parameter a only supplies the minuend of safeSub.
Parameter b only supplies the subtrahend checked by safeSub.
Parameter a only feeds the overflow-checked multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b only feeds the overflow-checked multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter a only supplies the dividend of safeDiv.
Parameter b only supplies the non-zero-checked divisor of safeDiv.
